verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish official SDKs, so the axis applies, but no evidence pack item documents one. The only programmatic surface is a keyless JSON endpoint on the Socrata open-data platform. That is a host-platform capability, and it is a raw API rather than an SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
